sync.title: Sync knowledge
sync.label: Sync

incremental.label: Incremental sync
incremental.description: Skip unchanged documents, update changed documents, and remove documents that no longer exist in the source.

replace.label: Replace matching documents
replace.description: Fetch documents from the source again and replace matching documents. Keep existing documents with no match.

complete.label: Full sync
complete.description: Fetch and rebuild all documents from this source. Keep documents from other sources.

sync.incrementalWarning: Incremental sync updates the segments of changed documents and skips unchanged documents.
sync.rebuildWarning: Sync deletes existing data before fetching fresh data. Proceed with care.

enabled.label: Enable scheduled sync
enabled.description: (Automatically sync documents in this knowledge on the configured schedule)

interval.minHoursMessage: The sync interval must be at least {count} hour. | The sync interval must be at least {count} hours.
interval.minMinutesMessage: The sync interval must be at least {count} minute. | The sync interval must be at least {count} minutes.

messages.taskInProgress: Skipped because another sync task is running or queued.
messages.syncDisabled: Skipped because scheduled sync is disabled.
